definition: Navigating a 3D environment by following natural-language instructions — an embodied AI task combining grounding and planning.
details: Navigating a 3D environment by following natural-language instructions — an embodied AI task combining grounding and planning.

explainer.lead: Vision-language navigation is the task of navigating a 3D environment by following natural-language instructions. It matters as an embodied AI task that combines grounding and planning.

tiers.eli5: Someone tells an agent in words where to go through a space, and it has to understand the words, match them to what it sees, and work out the route.
tiers.practitioner: Practitioners frame it as an embodied task requiring both grounding of language in the scene and planning of a route. A pitfall is treating grounding and planning separately when the task requires combining them.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as navigating a 3D environment by following natural-language instructions, an embodied AI task combining grounding and planning.

explainer.example: An agent in a 3D environment is given a natural-language instruction and must navigate accordingly.
